entities.summary: Saint Meinrad Archabbey is a Catholic monastery in Spencer County, Indiana, US, was founded by monks from Einsiedeln Abbey in Switzerland on March 21, 1854, and is home to approximately 67 monks. The Saint Meinrad Seminary and School of Theology is also located on the premises.
